name: blacklist-not-in-cache-key
body: `rust.apg.cache.manifest.ScanConfigKey` is the cache key and excludes the scan blacklist. `rust.apg.scan.cmd_scan` attempts the warm probe only when the current blacklist is empty, and `rust.apg.warm.warm_prepared` requires a stored unit for every source-manifest entry (`rust.apg.cache.factstore.FactStore.candidate`). A whole-file blacklist drops the file's unit, so the probe misses and the scan takes the ordinary path; a partial-declaration blacklist (a struct/function FQN prefix) leaves the file's unit present, and `rust.apg.incremental.record` derives every fragment via `rust.apg.cache.fragment.FileIndex.build` over the assembled graph, so a reused fragment is the blacklist-filtered fragment verbatim. `rust.apg.ingest.blacklist.is_blacklisted` filters only the spool; `rust.apg.ingest.splice_cached` inserts cached nodes and edges directly. Warm reuse is correct within one effective scan configuration, so `requirements.requirement.fast-project-start` AC2 holds for the same-config warm path.
